theorem large_q_hS {q : ℕ} (hq : 22000000000 ≤ q) {R : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R < lamQ q) :
    Real.log q + 1.039 * R ≤ 1.03 * ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) :=

note: Lemma 12.2.3 with σ = c₊ gives denominator log Q + 1.312, not log Q + c_E, so the claim that smaller R are covered needs σ ≈ 1.3471 (c(σ) ≈ 0.908616); Lean avoids this by proving regionS with c_E. Erratum: The sentence after (12.29), that all smaller R are covered by Lemma 12.2.3 with sigma = c_+, does not follow: in the admissible case q = 2^9 5^9, s = 1, Q0 = 3*10^9, rho = 0.6, R = 3 fails (12.29) (threshold 101.8) and the lemma gives 0.615201 where (12.23) needs 0.614865. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_12_29.py`).
